items.title: From prediction market to next-gen exchange: can $40 billion Kalshi IPO next year?

items.title: Shennan Circuits: controlling shareholder proposes 2026 cash dividend of at least 35% of net profit
items.summary: Shennan Circuits (002916.SZ) received a proposal from its controlling shareholder to pay 2026 cash dividends (including buyback amounts treated as dividends) of at least 35% of net profit attributable to shareholders.
items.title_zh: 深南电路：控股股东提议2026年度现金分红总额不低于净利润35%
items.summary_zh: 深南电路 (002916.SZ)公告称，公司收到控股股东深天科技控股出具的2026年度现金分红提议函，建议公司在符合利润分配条件、未发生超出既定计划的重大投资或重大现金支出需求，且不影响公司持续经营和长期发展的前提下，公司2026年度现金分红总额（包括可视同现金分红的回购股份金额等）不低于当年归属于上市公司股东的净利润
